title: Naturally Textured Sandstone Floor Tile
details: Naturally Textured Sandstone Floor Tile. Match the corresponding element in the original room reference; isolate only this named part.
prompt_used: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate exactly ONE standalone pixel-art environment tile: G04 Naturally Textured Sandstone Floor Tile, for local skl-SF Godot Map Factory. Input 1 is the original room reference: use only its golden sandstone floor material, warm sunlight palette and player-facing square-grid RPG camera; do not reproduce the room, characters, text or UI. Inputs 2,3,4 are owner-designated approved G01/G02/G03 64x64 floor reference tiles. Match their scale, restrained pixel density, brightness, thin subtly worn edge, warm golden sandstone and square outline closely. New G04 must have a unique naturally textured but clean surface with sparse subtle mineral-grain mottling, not cracks; stay in the same brightness family. One asset only filling the square canvas edge-to-edge, opaque background, square-grid 1x1 footprint, native game resolution exactly 64x64 pixels. If the renderer requires larger resolution, use an exact integer enlargement of a 64x64 pixel design with crisp aligned pixel blocks so nearest-neighbor normalization retains true pixels. Top face only, no visible side thickness, no perspective diamond, no heavy bevel, no dark border, no shadow outside the tile. Seamless repeatable edges, subtle seam behavior, quiet detail, no obvious central motif. Warm upper-left ambient sunlight, no baked diagonal cast shadow. No blur, smoothing, anti-aliasing, painterly texture, 3D appearance, labels, text, watermark, checkerboard, collage, atlas, characters, UI or extra objects. Return exactly one PNG tile. Do not replace G01, G02 or G03.
